contract: C11, docs/protocol.md. The relay (stage 3) checks its model against these vectors; the daemon (stage 4) gives the socket path and end_scope. Every value is a sample; the list of the samples' scope is ["a.example"]. Since board ab-v16.30 the vectors hold the per-scope rules (the no-list 503 and the 1008 closes, the refusals per scope, and with keys on the key's 403, the order of the checks and the key cases): the relay meets them from part 2 (boards ab-v16.35 and ab-v16.36) on.
scopeListNote: The list of the samples' scope: the refusals and passes per scope are checked against it.
mainFrameIdNote: The id of the sample tab's own target: a Page.navigate with this frameId, or with none, navigates the main frame.

keys.note: With keys on (the design's choice 1 b): each session's key, 64 lowercase hex digits, and its hash, the SHA-256 of those 64 ASCII characters in lowercase hex. Samples only.

upgradeChecksNote: The order of the checks before the upgrade (C11). keys: the relay runs with --keys. relay: the link, bridge.info (1 or more: an answer; 0: too old; null: no answer yet) and the name of the last allowlist line (lines) or null. answer: the id of an upgradeAnswers entry, or status 101 (the upgrade).
